The very first fragrance that I ever recall enjoying enough to buy with my own money was Light Blue Italian Zest

I still have my bottle from many many years ago with the tiniest bit of juice left and, objectively, it smells like lemon pledge surface cleaner. So would I buy it today if it hadn't been discontinued? Absolutely not. But it was the fragrance that sparked a teen girls interest in the perfume world and for that I owe it a great debt.
